mapper.insert: INSERT INTO menu_template(name, template_type, scene, flavor, crowd, description, status, created_by, remark) VALUES (#{name}, #{templateType}, #{scene}, #{flavor}, #{crowd}, #{description}, #{status}, #{createdBy}, #{remark})

INSERT INTO menu_template_dish(template_id, dish_id, sort_order, remark) VALUES
(#{item.templateId}, #{item.dishId}, #{item.sortOrder}, NULL)
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, template_type, scene, flavor, crowd, description, status, created_by, remark, created_at, updated_at FROM menu_template ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT dish_id FROM menu_template_dish WHERE template_id = #{templateId} ORDER BY sort_order ASC, dish_id ASC

SELECT i.id AS ingredientId, i.name AS ingredientName, i.unit AS unit, SUM(di.amount_g) AS totalAmountG FROM menu_template_dish mtd INNER JOIN dish_ingredient di ON di.dish_id = mtd.dish_id INNER JOIN ingredient i ON i.id = di.ingredient_id WHERE mtd.template_id = #{templateId} GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.unit ORDER BY i.id ASC
